newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-ROBSON LOOKS TO DJORKAEFF FOR RUSSIA CENTENNIAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROBSON LOOKS TO DJORKAEFF FOR RUSSIA CENTENNIAL.

text.p: French striker Youri Djorkaeff and Brazil's Bayern Munich star Giovane Elber head a World XI assembled by former England manager Bobby Robson to face Russia on Monday night in a match celebrating 100 years of Russian soccer.
President Boris Yeltsin will attend the match which also marks the re-opening of Moscow's 82,000-seat Luzhniki stadium after a two-year $200 million refurbishing.
Rest of the World - Goalkeepers - Andoni Zubizarreta (Spain/Valencia), Uwe Gospodarek (Germany/Bochum)
Defenders - Ramon Vega (Switzerland/Tottenham Hotspur), Frank Verlaat (Netherlands/VfB Stuttgart), Lothar Matthaeus (Germany/Bayern Munich), Claudio Suarez (Mexico/Guadalajara)

Midfielders - Aaron Winter (Netherlands/Internazionale), Julen Guerrero (Spain/Atletico Madrid), Peter Nowak (Poland/1860 Munich), Abedi Pele (Ghana/1860 Munich), Stefan Effenberg (Germany/Borussia Moenchengladbach)

Forwards - Roberto Baggio (Italy/Bologna), Youri Djorkaeff (France/Internazionale), Jean-Pierre Papin (France/Bordeaux), Andrei Shevchenko (Ukraine/Dynamo Kiev), Giovane Elber (Brazil/Bayern Munich), Andrzej Juskowiak (Poland/Bayern Munich)
Russia - Goalkeepers - Stanislav Cherchesov (Tirol), Sergei Ovchinnikov (Benfica)

Defenders - Viktor Onopko (Oviedo), Yuri Nikiforov (Sporting Gijon), Akhrik Tsveiba (Alania Vladikavkaz), Dmitry Khlestov (Spartak Moscow), Yuri Kovtun (Dynamo Moscow), Dmitry Popov (Compostela), Igor Chugainov (Lokomotiv Moscow)

Midfielders - Andrei Kanchelskis (Fiorentina), Andrei Tikhonov, Dmitry Alenichev (both Spartak Moscow), Igor Yanovsky (Alania Vladikavkaz), Yevgeny Kharlachev, Alexei Kosolapov (both Lokomotiv Moscow), Oleg Veretennikov, Valery Yesipov (both Rotor Volgograd), Sergei Grishin (Dynamo Moscow)
Forwards - Igor Kolyvanov (Bologna), Vladimir Beschastnykh (Racing Santander), Igor Simutenkov (Reggiana), Dmitry Cheryshev (Sporting Gijon)
